    rows.sort()
    cur=m.get("regularMarketPrice")
    prev=m.get("previousClose") or m.get("chartPreviousClose")
    last_date=datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(rows[-1][0]).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    last_close=rows[-1][1]
    # completed daily closes: exclude today's partial if last_date == today
    today=datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    comp=[c for t,c in rows if datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(t).strftime("%Y-%m-%d") < today]
    last30=comp[-31:]  # 31 closes -> 30 changes
    ups=sum(1 for i in range(1,len(last30)) if last30[i]>last30[i-1])
    n=len(last30)-1
    r3=(last30[-1]/last30[-4]-1)*100 if len(last30)>=4 else None
    r7=(last30[-1]/last30[-8]-1)*100 if len(last30)>=8 else None
